pins.definition: A picture painted on canvas or another surface and hung on a wall.
A visual representation, such as a drawing, painting, or photograph.
A work of art made with paint on a canvas or other surface.

situation: An artist stands before a large blank canvas in a sunlit studio, holding a wooden palette loaded with vibrant colors and a fine brush.
subject: a picture made with paint
brief: A woman stands before a tall easel in a sunlit studio, holding a wooden palette loaded with thick dabs of bright oil paint. On the canvas before her, a rich, colorful landscape is half-finished, with distinct brushstrokes and dripping pigments visible across the surface.
prompt: A woman stands before a tall easel in a sunlit studio, holding a wooden palette loaded with thick dabs of bright oil paint. On the canvas before her, a rich, colorful landscape is half-finished, with distinct brushstrokes and dripping pigments visible across the surface. thick impasto oil on canvas, visible loaded brushwork and palette-knife ridges, deep varnish tones, old-master lighting. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
